title: Miscarriage predicted effector genes (Laisk T et al. 2020)
bodyHtml:
This table displays results from the study:

The genetic architecture of sporadic and multiple consecutive miscarriage.
Laisk T, et al.
Nat Commun. 2020 Nov 25;11(1):5980. doi: 10.1038/s41467-020-19742-5.
PMID: 33239672

The authors performed multi-ancestry GWAS meta-analyses of genetic associations for sporadic and recurrent miscarriage and compiled several evidence types for each gene at the GWAS significant loci. Mouse over the column headers for details about each evidence type.
